description: This file contains data models and logic related to usage statistics and display for a gateway, including structures for windows, providers, summaries, and usage rows, along with a loader for retrieving usage data asynchronously.

classes.name: GatewayUsageWindow
classes.description: Represents a time window and its usage percentage for a gateway.

classes.name: GatewayUsageProvider
classes.description: Contains information about a usage provider, including its windows and plan.

classes.name: GatewayUsageSummary
classes.description: A summary that includes an update timestamp and a list of providers.

classes.name: UsageRow
classes.description: Represents a display row for gateway usage, including computed properties for display logic.

methods.name: primaryRows
methods.description: Computes a list of UsageRows from the providers in the summary.
